messages.content: 在壓力為10千帕的情況下，水的凝固點是多少？

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which to calculate the boiling point.

pressure.description: The pressure at which to calculate the boiling point. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of the pressure. Default is 'kPa'.

message.content:
在 10 kPa（約 0.1 atm）的壓力下，水的凝固點（即冰點）幾乎與標準大氣壓下的 0 °C 相同。  
根據水的相圖，三相點（冰–水–蒸氣）位於 6.112 kPa、0.01 °C；在此之上，冰的熔點隨壓力變化非常緩慢，斜率約為 –0.0001 °C/kPa。  
因此：

\[
T_{\text{freeze}}(10\,\text{kPa}) \approx 0\,^\circ\text{C} - (10-6.112)\,\text{kPa}\times 0.0001\,^\circ\text{C/kPa}
\approx -0.0004\,^\circ\text{C}
\]

換句話說，10 kPa 下水的凝固點約為 **0 °C**（差異可忽略不計）。

Actually, ice has lower density, so ΔV = V_liquid - V_solid > 0? Wait, water expands when freezing, so V_solid > V_liquid? Actually, ice is less dense, so V_solid > V_liquid, so ΔV = V_liquid - V_solid < 0. So dT/dP negative. The slope magnitude is about -0.0075 K/kPa? So slope between 6.112 and 101.3 is (0 - 0.01)/(101.3-6.112) = -0.01/95.188 = -0.000105 K/kPa. That's very small. So at 10 kPa, melting point is about 0°C - (10-6.112)*0.000105 = 0 - 3.888*0.000105 = -0.000408°C. So essentially 0°C. So freezing point at 10 kPa is essentially 0°C.
